criteria.statement: A fresh worker can determine objective, current state, lifecycle and next proof from repository state alone.
Material baseline objects expose origin and verification and can be traced without chat memory.
A material new aspect cannot pass the integration contract without explicit impact and one allowed disposition.
The operating model distinguishes autonomous AI work, candidate-only work, human authority and specialist escalation.
Material work can be reviewed against an explicit cross-domain competence taxonomy including interface competencies.
Material decisions can record current SOTA/best practice and why it does or does not fit the project.
Every must requirement has at least one criterion and every referenced verification exists in the canonical catalog.
Routine project-operation steps are candidates for automation and owner review measures remaining human clerical burden.
No baseline contract requires the produced system itself to contain AI or a fixed application stack.
Technology choices require project-fit reasoning and the baseline prescribes no database, backend, ML or deployment stack.
Verification entries declare deterministic, procedural or judgement class and CI does not claim judgement validity.
The dependency-free CLI executes validation and supports inspect, context, integrate, trace, derive and audit commands.
